limitations: All five PDF pages were examined in extracted text and as rendered pages. The document has no numbered chapters or printed page numbers; CH00 is an editorial container. Every printed-page citation is null, with one-based PDF positions and actual section names retained.

The record unit is a distinct substantive assertion, proposed action, open question, glossary/date entry or named registry entry. Repeated topical assertions are consolidated with multiple citations. Bibliographic entries remain separate provenance records; the six digest assertions remain separate content records. The result is not a count of unique tasks, unique incidents or approved household instructions.

The source supplies no author, publisher, copyright year or reliable issuance date. DLA wording and apparent office mappings do not authenticate official authorship. Its PDF generator metadata is not an authenticated publication timestamp; the October 29 metadata preceding an October 30 digest is recorded without inferring fabrication.

No final U.S. incident forensic report, complete affected-base inventory, shared U.S./French vulnerability, actor attribution, audited loss total or DLA medical-stock loss was established. Reuters is original attributed journalism, not an official incident determination.

Cathay and Orange company announcements corroborate what those companies stated. They are not independent audits of incident scope, containment, security performance or AI effectiveness. No news incident or AI product is classified as verified guidance.

DLA role verification is limited to the official search excerpt because direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403. The CISA evidence uses its official subscription bulletin, whose relevant text was read; a direct CISA PDF fetch was blocked. NIST evidence is limited to the actual CSRC abstracts and publication metadata, not a full-manual or compliance assessment.

The five office-code pairs and five FSC impact associations remain source-derived metadata, without current directory/catalog certification. Six relative sitrep links lack their host; no guessed URLs were created and the linked reports were not examined. Three source-article UUIDs are not article URLs; the first article instead supplies an aggregator-shaped URL.

The digest is mixed unrelated news. DoorDash/ADT announcements were checked for transaction status and value basis. Exact crypto loss/freeze amounts, PAG deal terms and the Ukraine-policy assertion remain unresolved. An operational status page does not verify a historical loss figure.
The source photograph was visually inspected but its original photographer, date, location and incident relationship were not authenticated. The caption alone cannot prove a cyberattack.

Household food-safety application is explicitly reviewer-added. Power-outage hold times do not guarantee safety during active defrost/heating or after an earlier unsafe warm interval. The food guidance does not apply automatically to refrigerated medicines, vaccines, industrial HACCP systems or DLA contracts.

Topic and milestone mappings are proposed vocabulary and editorial relevance, not app IDs or readiness credit. Background news, routing and bibliography receive reference-only context. All execution remains held; no controller testing, system modification or agency contact occurred.

record.title: Protect operational technology against activity targeting PLCs
record.locator: July 30, 2026 bulletin; exposure warning and defensive mitigations
record.finding: CISA describes risks from publicly exposed OT and advises protected remote access, password protection and exposure reduction. This bulletin concerns water-sector PLCs; it does not investigate the freezer incidents.

record.title: SP 800-161 Rev. 1, updated 2024: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices
record.locator: CSRC publication abstract and revision metadata; not a review of the full manual
record.finding: The abstract directly supports identifying, assessing and mitigating cybersecurity risks in acquired products and services. It does not verify a particular provider, DLA policy or incident.

record.title: SP 800-82 Rev. 3: Guide to Operational Technology Security
record.locator: Publication abstract and metadata; not a review of the full manual
record.finding: OT security must account for physical-system performance, reliability and safety. Revision 3 remains the final publication shown; the page identifies Revision 4 as an initial public draft.

record.title: Personal data security incident involving a third-party service provider
record.locator: October 30, 2026 notice; affected records, fields, payment qualifier and operating status
record.finding: Cathay reports approximately 53000 affected bookings, mostly names, flights and references, with additional possible fields for a subset. It reports no evidence of financial/payment access and no effect on its own operations. These are company statements, not an independent forensic audit.

record.title: Orange Cyberdefense becomes Mistral AI European MSSP design partner
record.locator: October 29, 2026 announcement; early access, use cases, oversight and European infrastructure
record.finding: The company announces early access to a Mistral Large 4 cybersecurity variant, gradual operational integration, European computing and human oversight. Planned benefits do not establish achieved results or universal necessity.

record.title: Military freezer malfunctions treated as suspected cyberattack
record.locator: October 29, 2026 original Reuters reporting by Raphael Satter, AJ Vicens and Phil Stewart; opening and French-freezer discussion
record.finding: Reports suspected hacking, at least six commissaries, late-August timing and a Fort Huachuca notice on August 26. French losses include an estimate. The article does not establish the U.S. controller brand or a common exploit. Original journalism provides attributed incident context, not official forensic confirmation.

record.title: Keep Food Safe After a Disaster or Emergency
record.finding: Appliance thermometers, refrigerator at or below 40 F, freezer at or below 0 F, closed-door 4/48/24-hour outage estimates, cold-source planning and no tasting to establish safety.

record.title: Emergencies: Food safety in Virginia
record.locator: Power-outage preparation, during and after an emergency
record.finding: Virginia reinforces thermometer use, closed-door outage estimates, ice/cooler planning, maintaining 40 F or below and discarding questionable food.

record.title: Food and Water Safety During Power Outages and Floods
record.locator: Before power emergencies and determining food safety after restoration
record.finding: FDA recommends appliance thermometers and warns that appearance/odor cannot establish safety and that thorough cooking may not make temperature-abused perishables safe. This examination does not adopt the page as an industrial cold-chain contract standard.

record.title: Food Safety During Power Outage
record.locator: Refrigerated and frozen item-specific tables, reviewed August 8, 2024
record.finding: The tables distinguish discard decisions after more than two hours at 40 F or above, category-specific exceptions and refreezing conditions. Ice cream and frozen yogurt are discarded even in the ice-crystal column. The outage estimates do not describe active heating or certify previously warmed food.

record.title: Distinguish a suspected attack from an established cause
record.guidance: Retain attribution and uncertainty for the U.S. incident. Temperature changes, similarities to France and public outage notices do not prove a malicious remote command, shared vulnerability, common actor or precise loss total. The Reuters account could not identify the U.S. controller manufacturer. General CISA OT risk guidance is not evidence that a particular freezer was attacked.

record.title: Keep booking units and privacy qualifiers intact
record.guidance: The affected unit is bookings, not necessarily unique passengers. The source omits possible additional personal fields affecting a smaller subset. Cathay reports no evidence of payment-data access; that is narrower than proof of no compromise. Company-reported containment and unaffected internal operations do not negate external data exposure. No DLA-specific travelers, cargo records or force movements have been established.

record.title: OT work needs an authorized physical-safety-aware process
record.guidance: Treat exposure reduction and OT safety as general defensive principles. The proposed DLA-wide firmware audit is not an established mandate or safe universal update procedure. Authorized operators should assess the actual equipment and vendor requirements, physical consequences and maintenance arrangements. This review supplies no live-system testing or controller modification instructions.

record.title: Institutional roles do not establish affected stock or contracts
record.guidance: DLA subsistence responsibilities are corroborated at excerpt level. They do not establish ownership of each commissary loss, medical-stock involvement, inventory volume, replacement cost, military use of a booking provider or applicable contract clauses. The four follow-on questions remain unanswered; proposed organizational actions must not be represented as official directives.

record.title: A partnership announcement is not a performance evaluation
record.guidance: Orange describes early access, intended use cases, gradual integration and expert oversight. European hosting is a location statement, not proof of security or compliance. No measured accuracy, investigation-speed improvement, universal AI necessity, household benefit or DLA deployment is established.

record.title: The photograph is an unauthenticated illustration
record.guidance: All five pages were visually inspected. The photograph shows supermarket freezer aisles with some products; the report provides no photographer, date, provenance chain or authenticated incident connection. A French label or a small notice cannot prove when, where or why stock was removed. No claim that the image is synthetic is made.

record.title: Do not manufacture an exact event or publication date
record.guidance: The report body and Reuters account describe late-August failures; its registry instead assigns August 1. Preserve that registry entry as an unresolved inconsistency, without inventing an exact event day. PDF metadata contains CreationDate and ModDate D:20261029160448 without a timezone while the document includes an October 30 digest. Metadata may be stale or inaccurate; it does not authenticate a publication date or prove fabrication.

record.title: Preserve financial values and transaction status
record.guidance: The DoorDash and ADT announcements concern proposed acquisitions rather than completed transactions. Approximately 17 billion dollars is the Instacart equity value. ADT gives 7.6 billion equity value and 15.3 billion enterprise value. Other digest loss amounts, a property-company stake and a military-policy claim remain unverified here. None is an investment recommendation or an explanation of household cold-storage risk.

record.title: Food safety depends on actual handling and temperature history
record.guidance: Reviewer-added application: use appliance thermometers and keep the refrigerator at or below 40 F and freezer at or below 0 F. Closed-door outage estimates are about 4 hours for a refrigerator and 48/24 hours for a full/half-full freezer; they are not guarantees for active defrost/heating or a previously warm appliance. Follow item-specific discard/refreeze tables and retain temperature history; present coldness cannot certify a prior unsafe warm interval. Never taste to test safety or assume cooking rescues temperature-abused food. Food guidance is not a medical-product storage rule or an industrial contract standard.
